title: P-Video Avatar
description: P-Video Avatar — a talking avatar from one image and a speech clip. Priced per second of the input audio, rounded UP to whole seconds, by output resolution: 40 credits/second at 720p, 60 credits/second at 1080p (e.g. a 12.4s clip at 1080p bills as 13s x 60).

audio.description: The speech/audio to lip-sync (mp3/wav, up to 30 seconds, max 5 MB). A public audio URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads.

image.description: The avatar image (a person facing the camera works best). A public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. jpg/png/webp.

resolution.description: Output resolution — sets the per-second price (720p = 40, 1080p = 60 credits/second).

video_prompt.description: Optional visual prompt describing how the person should appear or behave while speaking.
